def count_nums(arr)
  arr.count do |num|
    digits = num.abs.digits
    if num < 0

    end
    digits.sum > 0
  end
end

problems.name: HumanEval_87_get_row

def get_row(lst, x)
  result = []
  lst.each_with_index do |row, r_idx|
    row.each_with_index do |val, c_idx|
      result << [r_idx, c_idx] if val == x
    end
  end

  result.sort do |a, b|
    if a[0] != b[0]
      a[0] <=> b[0]
    else
      b[1] <=> a[1]
    end
  end
end

  primes_fibs = []
  a, b = 0, 1

    a, b = b, a + b

    (2..Math.sqrt(a).to_i).each do |i|
